name: UK strikes & disruption
summary: Consultants in England strike from 25 Nov for two days; RMT Tube strikes are listed from 26 Nov
state: The BMA said on 26 Oct that consultants in England will strike from 06:59 on 25 Nov to 06:59 on 27 Nov, with emergency cover continuing. RMT strikes on London Underground are listed from 26 Nov, with eight dates planned in total, according to Strike Calendar's listing updated on 8 Nov. These are strikes in single sectors, within the Watch band. No nationwide infrastructure failure had been found as of 8 Nov.
for_you: Patients with planned NHS care in England and London commuters are most exposed. The NHS and TfL publish service information as dates approach.
rubric_hit: Watch: national strike in one sector (consultants, England, 25–26 Nov). Alert line of multiple simultaneous national strikes or nationwide infrastructure failure not met.

sources.title: BMA — Consultants in England to take strike action in November

why: Strikes and infrastructure failures in rail, health, ports and power disrupt daily life and the economy.
drivers: Pay disputes, infrastructure failures, cyber incidents, weather.

rubric.alert: Multiple simultaneous national strikes, or nationwide infrastructure failure.
rubric.watch: National strike in one sector or major infrastructure disruption.
rubric.normal: No national-scale strikes or disruption this week.
